contexts.text: These Worlds of Spirits are very full...
The Sensuous... is filled with material ideas...
Thou shalt fill it with a filling of stone () = truths themselves in their order from one good. Explained.
They shall be enclosed in gold in their fillings () = that each and all things in general and in particular must proceed from the good which is of love from the Lord to the Lord. Explained.
To fill with evil and the falsity of evil. Signified.
